title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026
summary: Our third year with our own stand, back in Hall 5.1.
body:
Two years after our first stand in 2024, Epsilon Publishing Group returns to Frankfurt for a third year — this time at Hall 5.1, Stand C20. Pelin Yılmaz and Merve Sarıhan will be on site across all five days for rights meetings.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/frankfurt-book-fair-2026/)
